projects.name: Prime Data Centers PHX01 Avondale Campus
projects.description: Five-building 240MW hyperscale campus on 66.5 acres in Avondale. Ground broken on first three 267,000 SF buildings (48MW each); on-site 250MW SRP substation commissioned for first 144MW.

sources.title: Prime Data Centers breaks ground PHX01 Avondale

projects.open_for: Active hyperscale build. MEP, power, and cooling packages for Buildings 1. 3.

projects.name: Fluidstack Luke Field AI Campus Lease
projects.description: AI infrastructure firm Fluidstack leased ~1.1M SF across two buildings at Luke Field industrial park near Luke Air Force Base. Tenant improvements and utility upgrades expected to follow lease signing.

sources.title: Fluidstack 1.1M SF Luke Field lease, Hoodline

projects.open_for: Post-lease. TI, utility upgrades, and data center fit-out specs opening.

projects.name: Cavan Signal Butte & Germann Industrial
projects.owner: Lovett Industrial / Peakline Real Estate Funds. Cavan Commercial
projects.description: 1.14M SF Class A cross-dock logistics facility on 55.68 acres in Glendale's Southwest Valley. Speculative build with 40-ft clear heights, 197 dock-high doors; Phase 2 adds ~623,000 SF. Three-building light industrial development at Signal Butte Road and Germann Road in Mesa Opportunity Zone. Completion targeted June 2027.

sources.title: North Park Logistics Center breaks ground, AZ Big Media

projects.open_for: Ground broken. Structural, MEP, and dock equipment specs active. Light industrial build. Building systems and site work specs.

projects.name: GO|99 North Industrial
projects.description: 1.1M SF Class A speculative warehouse on 75 acres in Tolleson near I-10. Largest single building GO Industrial has developed; fills void in 1M+ SF megawarehouse market.

sources.title: Construction begins GO|99 North, AZ Big Media
1.1M SF industrial breaks ground West Valley, In Business Phoenix

projects.open_for: Active megawarehouse build. Structural, roofing, and MEP packages.

projects.name: Formation Park 10 Phase II
projects.description: Three-building 261,168 SF expansion at Formation Park 10 in Goodyear, bringing campus to ~689,000 SF on 44 acres at Bullard Avenue and Celebrate Life Way near I-10.

sources.title: Formation Park 10 Phase II, Connect CRE

projects.open_for: Just broken ground. Industrial building systems and tenant-ready specs.

projects.name: Aligned Data Centers Peoria Campus
projects.description: Aligned Data Centers advancing a two-building data center complex in Peoria as part of the metro Phoenix data center boom alongside Prime and Fluidstack activity.
key_specs: Part of Phoenix data center surge

sources.title: Arizona data center market activity, Rose Law Group / industry reports

projects.open_for: Data center build-out. Power and cooling infrastructure specs.

projects.name: Valencia Airport Center
projects.description: 163,000 SF industrial facility near Tucson International Airport. $25M investment with Q2 2027 occupancy target.

sources.title: Arizona industrial construction activity, AZ Big Media synthesis

projects.open_for: Under construction. Industrial envelope and MEP specs.
